root_idea.summary: The root centers on difficulty, elevation, or roughness, and extends to the displeasure or grievance arising from what is difficult or objectionable.
root_idea.development: The physical image of a raised step, threshold, or rugged ascent develops into meanings of hardship, reproach, and resentment, then into returning from conduct that caused displeasure and restoring goodwill.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form X perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular passive-participial citation form مُعْتَب rather than the Quranic plural مُعْتَبِين.

senses.definition: To solicit favor or reconciliation, asking to be restored to another’s good will or to conduct that pleases him.
senses.usage_conditions: The active Quranic use expresses seeking or petitioning favor. In the Quranic context, the requested favor is God’s, and the requested return is to conduct pleasing to Him.

senses.definition: To be asked to return to pleasing conduct, or to be allowed or accepted back into favor.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense represents the passive Quranic construction. The passages are interpreted either as denying the condemned any further opportunity to seek a return to what pleases God, or as denying that they will be restored to favor.

senses.definition: Regarded with favor; accepted back into good will or reconciliation.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مُعْتَبِين is used in a construction denying that the condemned will be restored to favor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be angry with, reproach, blame, or censure someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reproach may arise from displeasure, especially friendly displeasure, and may express a desire that the person abandon the conduct causing the grievance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tread upon or approach the threshold of someone’s door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional verbal construction referring to the threshold of a door.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To limp, halt, or hop on one foot or three legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or animal whose gait is impaired, including a hamstrung or distorted leg.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For lightning to flash in continued succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form I construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass from place to place, or shift from one statement or matter to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative movement from one location, saying, or subject to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For travelers to turn aside and settle in a place away from the intended direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized journeying construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or construct a threshold or step.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of making a threshold or a step by which one ascends.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw together and fold the tuck of one’s garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional garment-adjustment expression, especially in preparation for active work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become slow, tardy, dilatory, late, or backward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported specialized use of Form II.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two people to reproach, blame, or expostulate with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exchange may be friendly and confidential, with each person recalling the other’s conduct and seeking to repair the relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discipline, train, exercise, or make tractable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of training horses so that they abandon undesirable habits and accept discipline.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a hide back into the tanning process.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or technical tanning expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant someone goodwill or favor, or to make that person pleased and content.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV may also mean to remove a complaint or reproach by returning from harmful conduct to conduct that satisfies the offended person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cancel a bargain, agreement, or compact with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form IV contractual use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return from evil, sin, or an offense, or to turn back or revert from a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The return may be from an evil action to conduct that restores another’s satisfaction, or more generally from an affair or course previously undertaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A persistent defect, swelling, or lameness in a bone or limb after an imperfectly set fracture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a physical defect remaining after the bone has been set; the same lexical field is extended to an animal’s impaired leg.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accuse someone of a crime, offense, or harmful act that he did not commit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V use involving false accusation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Not to be subject to reproach, blame, or censure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in impersonal or passive constructions stating that no reproach is directed at someone concerning a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain at or keep to the threshold of a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form V construction involving a door threshold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recede, retreat, or turn back after proceeding in a direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of retreating in a route or withdrawing from the course being followed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave the even, easy part of a road and take the rugged part.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII route construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ascent is described as proceeding over or through a difficult mountain route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue a right or direct course in a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VIII use, synonymous with taking a deliberate or direct course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to cancel a bargain, agreement, or compact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X contractual request distinct from soliciting goodwill generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who reproves, blames, or censures frequently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reproving may be directed at a companion or friend, often from solicitous affection or displeasure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The frets or transverse ridges of a lute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized musical-instrument sense, apparently based on the image of a series of steps.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rugged places or ascents of mountains; ruggedness of ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of difficult terrain and its raised or ascending places.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The space between two mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The space between the fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact fingers or measurement convention vary in the lexical reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bend or bluntness in the striking part of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figuratively, the term can describe bending or recoiling in obedience or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unsoundness or an impairing defect in an animal’s leg or in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense covers physical impairment and its figurative extension to something vitiated or impaired.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A door threshold, lintel, or step.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The principal sense is the lower part of a doorway upon which one treads; the word also denotes a single step in a series.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife, by metonymic extension from the threshold of a house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative conventional use, not a literal architectural meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two named figures in geomancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use referring to the outer and inner figures called the two thresholds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extreme side or bend of a valley next to the mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical use with variant explanations for the precise part of the valley intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hardship, difficulty, or hateful and trying affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for being driven or subjected to an afflictive matter, including the severities of death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodwill, favor, satisfaction, or the restoration of a relationship after displeasure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can denote returning from an offense to conduct that pleases the reprover, and by extension simply returning from an evil action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reproach or evidence of restored favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is disputed: some lexical reports equate it with restoration of favor, while another report restricts it to reproving someone for harmful conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A male hyena; in a related expression, a female hyena.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is tentatively connected with the animal’s limping gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One upon whom reproach, blame, or censure has no effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive noun or adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road or way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical report with no further construction supplied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A town or village containing little good or few good things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used attributively of a settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speech with which someone is reproved, blamed, or censured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the words or discourse exchanged in reproach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reproved, blamed, or censured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The normal passive description is مَعْتُوبٌ عَلَيْهِ, someone against whom reproach is directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Corrupting, vitiating, or rendering unsound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This alternative interpretation is attributed to one authority and is explicitly reported with uncertainty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Turning away or having turned away from a prior direction or attachment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial use corresponding to the Form VIII sense of receding or turning aside.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opportunity or occasion for soliciting favor or reconciliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun corresponding to اِسْتِعْتَاب, used especially in the expression that no such request remains after death.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The simpler anger sense is covered with reproach and displeasure.
The step construction is grouped with making a threshold.
Contains both the Form IV restoration branch and an explicit Quran-linked interpretation.
General turning back is grouped with returning from evil.
Mutual reproach is already represented under the Form III/Form VI branch.
Contains the active solicitation sense and the passive Quranic restoration interpretation.
Abstract ruggedness is grouped with rugged mountain terrain.
The noun’s bone-defect specialization is grouped with the corresponding Form IV physical defect.
The single-step sense is grouped with the threshold/step branch.
The intensive reprover noun is grouped with the synonymous frequent-reprover branch.
Contains the normal passive sense and a separately preserved uncertain alternative.

cautions: The Quranic Form X group contains both active and passive surface forms. The active use solicits favor, while the passive construction concerns being asked or allowed to return to favor; Lane records competing interpretations of the related Quranic reading.

The passive participle مُعْتَبِين is presented under the singular dictionary citation مُعْتَب. The reported alternative sense of مُعْتُوبٌ as “corrupting” is retained separately because its source marks it as uncertain.
The meaning of عِتْبَانٌ is disputed in the lexical evidence: it is reported both for restored favor and for reproach.
